card.title: What Are We Now?
card.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do I bring my own towel when I visit now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I leave, shall I hang it back there or put it with the guest laundry?

mechanism: A uses towel access and storage to discover whether their former personal place is still part of the home.
confusable: Unlike housekeeping alone, successive distinctions must test guest status versus continuing belonging without naming a label.
comparison: D78-b asks where the towel belongs after departure; D78-a asks whether to join family or wait apart.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
